summary: Published the cypress-realworld-app holdout falsification receipt as a FAIL, recorded with pass-level rigor. New core schema derives the whole receipt from the byte-bound committed run evidence (parser/renderer/verifier/corpus-record, barrel-exported); canonical receipt.json/md emitted via a new CLI publisher. The holdout appears as an explicit holdouts record in aggregate.json and corpus coverage.productionReadiness, never as a fixture row or Judge counting cell; conformance and trust both independently refuse a dropped, counted, or unreported holdout. Aggregate/conformance/trust regenerated (vp pack before trust:generate). Numerators measured unchanged at reactLineage 3/4, angularLineage 2/4. All ten verify commands pass; suite 1260/1260; freeze fingerprint intact.
open_questions: The holdout record sits at coverage.productionReadiness.holdouts rather than a top-level CorpusConformance key: payment-signals.ts recognizes the conformance document by a closed root-key set, and adding a root key would have un-admitted the source-application git revisions as PAN-like. That file was outside the contract, so nothing was loosened. If a top-level holdouts key is wanted later, payment-signals.ts must be in the contract.
